DESCRIPTION: `_tokenize_for_similarity()` removes negators like `not` and `no` before `_finding_similarity()` runs. I verified `_finding_similarity("authentication required", "authentication not required") == 1.0`, and `ConvergenceDetector._compute_equivalence_classes()` collapses those contradictory findings into one class. Because the same helper also drives novelty-rate and duplicate-rate calculations, opposite findings can be miscounted as duplicates across convergence, diminishing-returns, and live fingerprint updates.  
PROPOSED_FIX: Preserve negation and other meaning-bearing tokens in the similarity pipeline, or encode negation explicitly before unigram/bigram comparison.

DESCRIPTION: the new “adaptive immune response” window logic is internally broken. `effective_window()` computes both `resolved` and `persistent`, but only `resolved` is used, `_sensitivity_decay` is never used at all, and the implemented behavior only widens the trigger window after a resolved episode. I verified with `stuck_window=3` that after one resolved kappa-stuck episode, the same pathology was not re-diagnosed until the 4th consecutive zero-kappa round. That is the opposite of the documented claim that repeated exposure should speed response.  
PROPOSED_FIX: implement one consistent adaptive-window rule that actually uses persistent and resolved counts as documented, and delete or wire in `_sensitivity_decay`.

DESCRIPTION: the health-monitor layer claims it can detect “D_decay frozen,” but there is no data path for that diagnosis. `DetectorDiagnosis` reserves a `d_decay` label and the comments advertise that pathology, yet `DetectorHealthMonitor.record_round()` accepts only `kappa`, `mu`, `novelty_rate`, `finding_count`, and `active_models`. `DynamicManager.process_round()` passes only those fields, even though `update_fingerprints()` computes fresh `D_decay` values every round. The advertised detector blind-spot check is therefore impossible to execute.  
PROPOSED_FIX: pass a D-decay summary or per-model D-decay series into `record_round()` and implement the promised pathology check, or remove the `d_decay` claim from the monitor design.
